title: PFD and Charge Pump Testbench
text: Generic test environment for phase/frequency detectors and charge pumps, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Phase sweep (°)} sets the maximum phase excursion from phase offset, {Phase offset (°)} sets the relative phase value at center of phase, {Clock frequency (Hz)} sets the desired reference clock frequency, {Number of phases in sweep} sets the total number of evenly spaced phase offsets, {Duty cycle (%)} sets the duty cycle of stimulus clock, {Plot figures on top after simulation}, {Report PFD metrics}, {Report Charge Pump metrics}, {Logic Threshold (V)} sets the switching threshold at input of charge, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Target deadband (°)} sets the maximum acceptable size of reduced sensitivity region near zero phase, {Target linear range (°)} sets the maximum phase offset at which the output remains approximately equal to the input, {Target propagation delay (s)} sets the maximum acceptable delay from input to output, {Target rise/fall time (s)} sets the maximum acceptable 20% – 80% rise/fall time, {Target sensitivity (A/°)} sets the maximum acceptable charge pump sensitivity, {Target phase offset (°)} sets the maximum acceptable phase offset at output of charge and {Target spur current (A)} sets the charge pump output current. Values come from the instance.
